description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_우체국 쇼핑 주문 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 우체국 쇼핑몰에서 판매되는 상품에 대한 접수데이터를 기반으로 하여 주문 일시, 발송인/수취인 주소 정보, 상품에 대한 카테고리, 부피, 중량 정보를 제공하며 상품의 배송과정에서 거치는 발송우체국, 도착우체국, 배달우체국 정보를 제공. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 우체국쇼핑, 주문, 접상품카테고리, 과학기술. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-04-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
